sections.h2: What should a Cutler Bay owner check first before selling?
sections.html:
Begin with the town's own paperwork, then the county's. Cutler Bay's website has pages for Permits and Inspections, Code Compliance, Property Registration and flood information, so a seller with unfinished work or an open code case can clear it before a title search turns it up.

Cutler Bay is a southern Miami-Dade town whose election notice says it is split into three residential districts. The site also carries Hurricane Preparedness pages and a Flood Awareness link, handy when a buyer asks about storms and insurance.

sections.h2: How is housing in Cutler Bay described by the Census?
sections.html:
The town's 44,750 residents in the 2025 estimate are 1.5 percent fewer than the 45,426 in the April 2020 base. On 9.89 land square miles it counted 4,594.4 people per square mile in 2020, and owners occupy 69.7 percent of homes.

sections.h2: How does commuting and work shape the Cutler Bay market?
sections.html:
Getting to work takes Cutler Bay residents 38.2 minutes on average, well past the 26.4 minute U.S. mark. In the labor force: 66.1 percent of people 16 and older.

  • Such a long average trip makes road access a talking point.
  • Retail sales hit $978,112 thousand in 2022, about $22,257 per person.

If your street has quick road access, say so in the listing.

sections.h2: Where is the Miami-Dade Property Appraiser for Cutler Bay owners?
sections.html:
The county appraiser keeps a regional branch in town, at the South Dade Government Center, 10710 SW 211 Street, 2nd Floor. Hours are weekdays 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM and the phone is 305-232-3810. Online booking is available.

This office sends no tax bills and sets no rates; the county tax collector handles both billing and collection. Its 2026 roll certification came on October 16, 2026, and the Value Adjustment Board can still adjust values after appeals. An Online Exemptions tool accepts widow and veteran disability filings.

sections.h2: What do deed taxes and recording cost for a Cutler Bay sale?
sections.html:
Deed tax in Miami-Dade is 60 cents per $100, plus a 45 cents per $100 surtax that a single-family-only transfer does not owe. The base rate lives in s. 201.02, and every party signing the deed is liable.

  • The tax is paid when the clerk records the deed.
  • Page fees are $5.00 then $4.00 each.
  • Two witnesses are required, and they may appear by audio-video.

You can also sign up with the county Clerk of Court and Comptroller for a free notice, sent within 24 hours, whenever a deed or mortgage is recorded in your name.

sections.h2: How do homestead and the Save Our Homes cap affect a Cutler Bay sale?
sections.html:
The cap keeps a homesteader's taxable value below market until a sale resets it. It is the smaller of 3 percent or CPI, and the state's chart shows 2.7 percent for 2026.

  • Homestead cuts up to $50,000; the first $25,000 also applies to school taxes.
  • The next owner starts at just value the following January 1.
  • Moving within Florida? Portability can carry up to $500,000 of savings to the new home if filed by March 1.

Buyers should use the appraiser's estimator before they assume your tax bill will carry over.

sections.h2: What if a Cutler Bay house has a tenant, an heir or a lender involved?
sections.html:
Timing differs for each. A tenant who misses rent gets 3 days, a monthly tenancy ends on 30 days' notice, and after a court judgment the sheriff posts 24 hours' notice.

  • Heirs may need a personal representative first; estates up to $150,000 can use the short route.
  • A lender's court sale follows judgment by 20 to 35 days.
  • Tax certificate holders wait two years from the April 1 of issue before applying for a deed.

A Florida attorney or the clerk can say which step fits your file.

sections.h2: What projects and services does the town list for residents?
sections.html:
The town's home page announces a planned Legacy Park and Municipal Complex on 16 acres in the heart of Cutler Bay, with a community park, Town Hall, Police Station and Community Center. It also lists golf cart registration, a Holiday Golf Cart Parade, an Active Adults program and a Floodplain Mitigation Plan Advisory Committee.

Those details tell a buyer the town runs its own parks, code and permit functions. Sellers can point to the Education Advisory Committee and the Schools page on the town site when buyers ask about local schools, and send them to the county for school boundary questions.

sections.h2: What does the Florida property tax calendar mean for a Cutler Bay seller?
sections.html:
The state calendar runs assessment on January 1, exemptions by March 1, notices in August, bills in November and delinquency from April 1. Value petitions go to the clerk 25 days after the notice.

A spring or summer closing leaves a full-year November bill still to come, so buyer and seller split it. The settlement statement should show the proration, and you can compare that line with the collector's record for your folio.

sections.h2: Which senior and veteran benefits might end when a Cutler Bay owner sells?
sections.html:
These Florida benefits tie to the home, so ask the appraiser how each applies before you list.

  • An extra exemption up to $50,000 for owners 65 and over, if a local ordinance permits and income qualifies.
  • A discount matching the VA percentage for veterans over 65 with a lasting service-connected disability.
  • $5,000 off for a disabled ex-servicemember rated 10 percent or more.
  • A Form DR-570 deferral, filed by March 31.

Cutler Bay has 1,053 veterans and 16.9 percent of residents at 65 or older, so these programs reach many local owners.

faqs.q: What does a Cutler Bay home typically cost?

faqs.a: Slightly the other way: 44,750 in 2025 is 1.5 percent under the 2020 base.

faqs.q: Does the surtax apply to my Cutler Bay deed?
faqs.a: No, if the document moves only a single-family dwelling. The 60 cents per $100 base tax still applies.

faqs.q: Where can I get help with an exemption?
faqs.a: The county appraiser's Cutler Bay branch at the South Dade Government Center, or its online exemption filing.
The Miami-Dade tax collector, each November, with 4 percent off for paying that month.
